'''2007 Maryland State Championship Sam Westergaard DS Endor''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Sam Westergaard]] at [[2007 Maryland State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor (Dark)|Endor-D-endor.gif|label=Endor}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' San Westergard
* '''Deck name:''' Kicker of Elves
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
